blocks.text: Zscaler provides a predefined gateway to direct Private Access (ZPA) application segment traffic marked for inspection from Internet & SaaS (ZIA) to Private Access, which is enabled by default. You cannot edit this gateway. You can also configure separate custom gateways to forward Source IP Anchored traffic to Private Access.
This page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Create Private Access gateway objects that can be used in forwarding policies to redirect Source IP Anchored application traffic to the destination servers via the Private Access App Connectors.
Map Private Access gateways to the Source IP Anchored Private Access server groups and the associated application segments.

blocks.heading: About the Private Access GW Page

blocks.text: On the Private Access GW page (Infrastructure > Internet & SaaS > Private Access GW), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Search for a Private Access gateway.
Modify the table and its columns.
View a list of all Private Access gateways. For each gateway, you can view the following information:
Gateway: The name of the gateway. You can sort this column.
Server Groups: The server group configured for this Private Access gateway.
Application Segments: The application segments that are associated with the configured server group.
Description: Additional notes or information about the gateway.
